people.name: Bethany
people.line: Village near Jerusalem, home of Mary, Martha, and Lazarus.

translations.web: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had led them out as far as Bethany, He lifted up His hands and blessed them.
translations.kjv: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
translations.asv: And he led them out until they were over against Bethany: and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
